steps.instruction: Move gently on the outer jugs, then add a few easy edge contacts. Keep your grip open and your shoulders engaged.
steps.title: Progressive warm-up

steps.instruction: Stay on the easy jugs and let your breathing settle before you step away.
steps.title: Cool down

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from the jugs for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Jug hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 1 pull-up on a round sloper.
steps.title: Sloper pull-up

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 10 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a pocket for 15 seconds and include 3 shrugs.
steps.title: Pocket hang + shrugs

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 20 seconds and include 2 pull-ups.
steps.title: Large edge + pull-ups

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for 10 seconds, then do 5 knee raises on a pocket.
steps.title: Sloper + knee raises

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 4 pull-ups on a large edge.
steps.title: Large-edge pull-ups

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 10 seconds.
steps.title: Medium-edge hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 3 pull-ups on the jugs.
steps.title: Jug pull-ups

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for as long as you can.
steps.title: Maximum sloper hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 15 seconds, then do 3 pull-ups.
steps.title: Large edge

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 2 pull-ups on a round sloper, then hang from a medium edge for 20 seconds.
steps.title: Sloper + medium edge

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a small edge for 20 seconds, then hold a pocket at a 90° bent arm for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Small edge + pocket

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for 30 seconds.
steps.title: Round sloper

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a large edge for 20 seconds, then do 4 pull-ups on a pocket.
steps.title: Large edge + pocket

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 3 offset pulls per arm with the high hand on a jug and low hand on a small edge; change hands and repeat.
steps.title: Offset pulls

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 15 knee raises on the jugs, then hang from a medium edge for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Knee raises + edge hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a medium edge for 25 seconds.
steps.title: Medium edge

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a slope for 15 seconds, then do 3 pull-ups on the jugs.
steps.title: Slope + jugs

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang from a round sloper for as long as you can.
steps.title: Maximum sloper hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hold a straight-arm hang on a large slope for 20 seconds, then do 3 pull-ups on a four-finger flat edge.
steps.title: Large slope + flat edge

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hold a slightly bent-arm hang on a large slope for 20 seconds; stay on for a 20-second L-sit or 20 hanging knee curls.
steps.title: Bent arm + core

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 5 pull-ups on a three-finger pocket; stay on for a 25-second straight-arm hang.
steps.title: Pocket pull-ups + hang

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Start at a three-finger pocket and move through every hold upward, staying on each for 5 seconds; finish with a 20-second large-slope hang.
steps.title: Hold ladder

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang one-armed from a four-finger flat edge for 20 seconds; switch hands and repeat.
steps.title: Single-arm flat edge

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 5 offset pull-ups with the top hand on a large slope and bottom hand on a three-finger pocket; change hands and repeat.
steps.title: Offset pull-ups

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hold a 90° bent-arm hang on a four-finger incut edge for 30 seconds, then a straight-arm three-finger-pocket hang for 15 seconds.
steps.title: Incut edge + pocket

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do 3 L-sit pull-ups, bending your knees if needed; then hold a 5-second front lever or 15-second straight-arm hang on a large slope.
steps.title: L-sit + lever

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Hang straight-armed for 20 seconds using only 2 fingers in three-finger pockets, then do 3 power pull-ups with weight or helper resistance.
steps.title: Two fingers + power pulls

steps.accessory: Follow the prescribed task times, then rest for the remainder of the cycle.
steps.instruction: Do a maximum slightly bent-arm hang on a large slope to failure with no rest, then a maximum straight-arm hang on the large slope.
steps.title: Maximum slope hangs

steps.instruction: Use added weight or assistance so seven seconds is near-max without losing shoulder position or grip shape.
steps.title: Max hang · set 1

steps.instruction: Repeat the same load or make a small adjustment. Stop before form breaks.
steps.title: Max hang · set 2

steps.instruction: Keep the effort high and the movement quiet. Do not turn this into a full-crimp test.
steps.title: Max hang · set 3

steps.instruction: Take the full recovery and reproduce your best controlled effort.
steps.title: Max hang · set 4

steps.instruction: Finish with one high-quality effort. Log the load or assistance used today.
steps.title: Max hang · set 5
